Order 
This is first application under Section 438 of Cr.P.C. for grant of anticipatory bail to the applicant.

The applicant apprehends his arrest in connection with Crime No.159 of 2024 registered at Police Station Ashoka Garden, District Bhopal (M.P.) for offence punishable under Sections 376 and 506 of the Indian Penal Code.

entities.text: Police Station Ashoka Garden, District Bhopal
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: I t is pointed out that the applicant has falsely been implicated in the crime.
He has not committed any offence in any manner.
It is further submitted that the prosecutrix is a consenting party.
It is submitted that the prosecutrix is a major aged about 30 years and is known to the present applicant.
She has not raised any alarm while going to the hotel with the applicant.
The applicant is the first offender.
He is ready to cooperate with the investigation and to abide by all the terms and conditions that may be imposed by this Court while considering the anticipatory bail application.
On these grounds, he prays for granting anticipatory bail to the applicant.
Per contra, counsel appearing for the State has opposed the application 2 MCRC-23261-2024 but could not dispute the fact that the applicant has no criminal past, as per the case diary records.

Considering the overall facts and circumstances of the case and commenting upon the merits of the case, this Court deems it appropriate to allow this application for grant of anticipatory bail subject to verification of the fact that the applicant is the first offender.

In the event of arrest, the applicant is directed to be released on bail on furnishing a surety bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of Arresting Officer.
